references.text: Earlier in the same chapter, the bitter water that brings a curse is mentioned, preparing for this act where the woman actually drinks the water.
Describes the consequences when the bitter water enters the woman if she has been unfaithful—the water brings a curse upon her.
Moses made the Israelites drink water mixed with dust from the golden calf as a form of divine test, similar to the use of bitter water as a trial.
The psalm describes a curse that enters the body like water, a parallel to the bitter water that brings a curse.
The Lord says he will give false prophets wormwood to eat and bitter water to drink, linking to the theme of bitter water as judgment.
Describes a cup of judgment and destruction that is to be drunk, similar to the bitter water that brings a curse in the jealousy offering.
